repository_requirements.detail: In-app CreditsView exposes the exact OtoLogic CC BY 4.0 credit and is reachable from HomeView.
Canonical and app-target PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declare only app-local UserDefaults reason CA92.1 and are archive-validated.
Display name and Japanese subtitle are within Apple's current 30-character limits; iOS privacy policy URL remains required.
All four planned Irasutoya resources remain not_yet_bundled in AssetManifest.json; no character binary resource is declared by Package.swift. Add and source-check actual files before marking bundled.
All three planned OtoLogic MP3 resources remain not_yet_bundled in AssetManifest.json; no audio binary resource is declared by Package.swift. Add the actual licensed files before marking bundled.
A final original 1024x1024 app icon must be supplied to the AppIcon asset catalog before App Store submission.
Simulator Debug, generic-device Release, unsigned xcarchive, and archived privacy-manifest checks have passed in CI.

submission_rule: Do not declare submission-ready until every repository requirement is complete and all remaining blockers are external operator/account inputs only.
